record.paper_title: Developments and open problems on chiral polytopes
record.original_question: Does every finite chiral polytope K with regular facets admit a finite chiral extension whose Schläfli symbol has any prescribed last entry?

evidence.quote: Problem 26 Does every chiral finite polytope K with regular facets admit a finite chiral extension with prescribed last entry of the Schlafli symbol?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
An abstract n-polytope is a partially ordered set generalizing the face lattice of a convex polytope, satisfying the standard axioms (bounded, all flags have length n+1, strong flag-connectedness, and the diamond condition). An abstract n-polytope is called regular if its automorphism group acts transitively on its flags, and chiral if its automorphism group has exactly two orbits on flags such that adjacent flags lie in different orbits. The Schläfli symbol {p_1, p_2, …, p_{n-1}} of such a polytope records the types of its rank-2 sections.

An (n+1)-polytope Q is called an extension of an n-polytope K if every facet of Q is isomorphic to K. If Q is a chiral extension of K, then the first n−1 entries of the Schläfli symbol of Q are determined by K, while the last entry p_n is a free parameter (subject to p_n ≥ 2).

Question: Does every finite chiral n-polytope K all of whose facets are regular admit, for every integer k ≥ 2 (or for every admissible value of the last Schläfli entry), a finite chiral (n+1)-polytope Q that is an extension of K and whose Schläfli symbol has last entry equal to k?
artifact.status_search_result: A 2021 paper by A. Montero ("On the Schläfli symbol of chiral extensions of polytopes") gives constructions of finite chiral extensions with controllable last Schläfli entry for certain classes of finite chiral polytopes with regular facets, including cases where the last entry can be made arbitrarily large. However, the constructions apply to specific classes rather than to all finite chiral polytopes with regular facets, so the general problem remains only partially solved.

status_evidence.title: On the Schläfli symbol of chiral extensions of polytopes
status_evidence.snippet: We introduce some constructions of chiral extensions of certain chiral polytopes ... in such a way that the last entry of the Schläfli symbol is arbitrarily large.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial constructions for specific classes of chiral polytopes with regular facets.

status_evidence.title: Chiral Extensions of Regular Toroids
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions of chiral extensions of regular toroidal polytopes.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial progress on chiral extensions in special cases.
